title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 0.1 Test 8
summary: Test 8 is an unsigned build of the portable green Mouse Without Borders fork. It keeps the Test 7 icon and minimal tray menu while making the About window fully opaque. Download `MouseWithoutBorders.exe` from Assets and use this same release on every computer.
changes: Makes the About window fully opaque instead of retaining the original form's 90% transparency.
Keeps the accepted pre-Test-5 green-and-black icon artwork restored in Test 7.
Keeps the minimal portable and installed tray menus introduced in Test 7.
Reduces temporary GitHub Actions artifact retention from 14 days to one day to prevent duplicate test builds from accumulating.
Documents the About-window and build-retention changes in the user, extraction, and developer guides.
testing: Open About over both a light and dark window and confirm nothing behind it shows through.
Confirm the About icon and EXE icon still show the complete accepted green-and-black artwork.
Confirm the portable tray menu contains Settings, About, and Exit; an installed copy should additionally contain Start with Windows and Uninstall.
Use this same Test 8 EXE on both computers and test mouse, keyboard, clipboard, file transfer, reconnect, firewall prompting, and sleep/wake behavior.
